notes.title: New Camera Modes added!
notes.content:
If navigating the unknown Eithode base was a bit obscure to navigate, now you can experience Mars with 2 all-new perspectives! First Person Mode can be activated from the Advanced PDH from holding (OK) and then pressing the (RUN) key. Or by accessing the [FPS item] in your inventory. The overhead Camera is still being polished, but the first-person mode is running smoothly for the most part. 
   I will be trying to test these modes thoroughly, and fixing bugs as I might find them! There are also some additional areas I have added, with some more rooms to be filled once I finish this current update!
